i: The last block of ice from the frozen wastes. Five hundred years old, and it hasn't melted a drop.
It's a normal block of ice. Everybody agrees it's the most important thing in the city.
1: The way out, to the Frost Ward.

objects.name: Old Torvi
lines: I come every day. I put my hand on it. Very cold.
My grandad put his hand on it. His grandad put his hand on it. It's a family thing. Our hands are freezing.

questions.ask: Why does nobody let it melt?
answer: Then it's water. Then it's Fliss selling it in tiny bottles.
As long as the ice is cold, the Kaldari remember the wastes. That's what my grandad said. His hand was blue.

questions.ask: Your family just licks a big ice cube.
answer: Touches. TOUCHES. My uncle licked it once.
He was stuck there a week. The family doesn't talk about Uncle Bo.

lines: A pile of letters, addressed TO THE WASTES. The newest is from a recruit called Leif.
'Dear Mum. The food is grey. The drillmaster can't count. I'm doing all right.'
